items.text: Most coverage of AI and Indian IT jobs sits at one of two extremes.
One extreme says AI is quietly wiping out India's IT industry.

visuals.title: Not the Panic Version

visuals.alt: Decision checks and steps for AI Impact on IT Jobs.
visuals.caption: Practical checks for AI Impact on IT Jobs.
visuals.heading: Not the Panic Version

items.text: Job categories inside IT are not one uniform block; a QA tester and a solutions architect face completely different AI exposure.
Falling entry-level hiring and rising AI-linked hiring are both true at the same time, in the same industry, in the same year.
Company headcount numbers alone do not tell you what kind of roles are shrinking and what kind are being added.

visuals.title: Not the Panic Version

items.text: Voice and chat-based AI support is already live at scale across large service providers.
Watch out: this does not mean coding is dead.

items.text: That review-and-accountability layer is a new, growing job category, not a shrinking one.
Buying an AI tool and getting real value from it are different problems.
